summary: Full backend + frontend testing for LKP HReDU app. Ran pytest suite (21/21 passing) covering courses, registrations with file upload to Emergent object storage, admin gate, certificate CRUD + case-insensitive verify, seed data, reviews CRUD. Ran Playwright end-to-end flows: landing page loads, registration form submits with PNG proof, /validasi returns Budi Santoso for HRDU/2026/0001 and not-found for unknown, /admin login with Pass123$$ shows all three tabs (Data Pendaftar, Data Sertifikat, Ulasan Google), proof modal opens with uploaded image. All specified requirements are met.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py init_storage() uses a module-level global `storage_key` without a lock — safe under uvicorn single-worker but could race if scaled; consider passing the emergent_key on every request or using an asyncio.Lock.

put_object/get_object are synchronous `requests` calls inside async FastAPI handlers — they will block the event loop. Recommend switching to httpx.AsyncClient or running via asyncio.to_thread for higher concurrency.
No file-size validation of the raw upload stream before reading fully into memory (10MB check happens after full read). Acceptable given the 10MB cap but worth noting.

Console hydration warning `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` visible in admin ReviewAdmin — caused by the Emergent visual-editor injecting instrumentation spans into <option>, not by app code. Ignorable at runtime.
